patterns_discovered.name: Pagination Normalization
patterns_discovered.description: Replaced offset/limit terminology with skip/limit to maintain consistency across API (matches files.py pattern)

patterns_discovered.name: Response Wrapper Pattern
patterns_discovered.description: Introduced SearchResponse wrapper containing items list plus metadata (total, skip, limit)
evidence: Both semantic and keyword paths return SearchResponse

patterns_discovered.name: Cache-Aside with Deterministic Keys
patterns_discovered.description: Caching layer integrated pre/post-processing with SHA256-hashed parameter objects

patterns_discovered.name: Dual-Path Search Symmetry
patterns_discovered.description: Semantic and keyword search paths unified with consistent response format and caching behavior

gotchas_discovered.issue: Cache Invalidation Strategy Relies Solely on TTL
gotchas_discovered.description: No explicit cache invalidation mechanism when underlying index changes; relies on 5-minute TTL expiry only
gotchas_discovered.risk: Stale results possible for up to 5 minutes after file system modifications
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider integrating with index update events or adding manual invalidation endpoint

gotchas_discovered.description: Semantic search uses _MAX_SEMANTIC (2000) while keyword search uses _MAX_LIMIT (1000) - different constraints
gotchas_discovered.risk: Inconsistent behavior between search modes; semantic search may return more results
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Document limit differences or unify constraints

gotchas_discovered.description: InMemoryCache has no explicit size limits; cache could grow indefinitely with diverse queries
gotchas_discovered.risk: Potential memory exhaustion in long-running server instances
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Implement cache eviction policy (LRU) or maximum size limits

gotchas_discovered.description: Cache key generation relies on json.dumps() with potential failure cases for non-serializable types
gotchas_discovered.risk: Edge cases with custom type parameters could break cache entirely
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Add try-except around cache key generation with fallback to non-cached path

recommendations.recommendation: Implement LRU eviction policy with maximum cache size to prevent unbounded memory growth
recommendations.rationale: InMemoryCache current implementation has no size limits; long-running servers could exhaust memory

recommendations.recommendation: Integrate cache invalidation with file index update events instead of relying solely on TTL
recommendations.rationale: Current TTL allows 5-minute window of stale results; event-based invalidation ensures consistency

recommendations.recommendation: Add integration tests for pagination edge cases (skip > total, limit=0, large offsets)
recommendations.rationale: Pagination logic is now core feature; edge cases should be validated

recommendations.recommendation: Add metrics for cache hit/miss rates and search performance to implementation_plan notes
recommendations.rationale: Performance optimization requires validation; metrics prove cache effectiveness

recommendations.recommendation: Document or unify _MAX_SEMANTIC (2000) vs _MAX_LIMIT (1000) asymmetry in search modes
recommendations.rationale: API consumers should understand why semantic search may return more results than keyword search
